name: Lyon
source:
A costumed performer at the Revue moving amusement park. His age is unknown.
He's reserved and calm, honest and kind and pure.
He's loved by children but for some reason cats hate him.
He keeps the costume on even when he's eating so few people know what he really looks like.

Hobby: Reading, Stargazing
